text:
一週之內，輝達的中國問題從「空殼公司」升級成「疑似美人計」。

美國情報研判黃仁勳可能是中國間諜行動的目標，國會已經點名要他出席。

真假還沒定論，但重點不是八卦。

如果出口管制的破口可能是 CEO 本人，輝達說 Megaspeed 跟中國沒關係，光否認就不夠了。

用 15% 分潤換來的對中銷售許可，我賭撐不過這次聽證會。

40 of 41.

That's how many local ballot measures went for data center restrictions this midterm.

Voters aren't anti-AI. They're anti-paying for AI's electric bill.

Big Tech spent two years locking down chips and power contracts. It forgot the one input it can't buy: a yes vote from the county next door.

The next AI bottleneck won't be a fab. It'll be a zoning hearing.

記憶體荒已經燒到你手上了。

Oppo 傳出砍掉一支旗艦機，高階電子書閱讀器一口氣漲 40 到 50 美元。

連輝達都傳出找台積電研究 3D DRAM。台積電雖然否認，但訊號很清楚：DRAM 已經不是大宗商品，是戰略物資。

蘋果有定價權，漲價轉嫁就好；小品牌只能砍產品或吞毛利。

明年手機發表會最常見的升級，可能是「規格不變、價格上漲」。

The US approved H200 sales to an office in China with exposed wires and nobody inside.

A reporter walking through the door did a better audit than Commerce or Nvidia.

That's not export control. That's a toll booth with a 15% fee.

Add smuggling and cargo theft, and the real question isn't whether chips leak. It's how many.

Prediction: the revenue-share deal is the first casualty of Huang's trip to Congress.

Coding agents made writing code nearly free.

Nobody made reviewing it free.

GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Google and Cursor are now fighting over the same layer: what ships, what gets tested, what gets rolled back.

The IDE war is over. The merge-button war just started.

Bet: within 18 months, 'senior engineer' mostly means 'the person who signs off on agent PRs.'

Free Chinese open-weight models now hack almost as well as gated frontier models.

OpenAI rates GPT-6 Cyber's exploit skills as critical.

So the gate everyone argued about? It's open. And your distro's patch queue didn't get any faster.

Attackers don't need the best model anymore. They need the second-best one, free, on a laptop.

The next big breach won't need a zero-day. It'll walk through a patch that sat unshipped for weeks.

OpenAI wanted $30B at a $1.25T valuation. It got $11B.

That's not a funding round. That's a signal.

Ramp data says enterprise AI spend is flattening. Chatbots are adding ads and raising prices.

When the most hyped company on earth starts monetizing like a media business, the growth story is over and the margin story begins.

Anthropic's IPO will be the first real price check on the whole sector.

AI 產業以為最大的瓶頸是 GPU，再來是電。

結果是鄰居。

美國期中選舉 41 個資料中心相關公投，40 個都支持限制；阿姆斯特丹還有抗議者直接衝進微軟工地。

蓋資料中心要拿地、拿電、拿許可，每一關背後都是選票。

台灣也在搶 AI 資料中心，但我們的電價跟供電穩定度，經得起同樣的民意檢驗嗎？

AI 寫 code 變便宜之後，真正變貴的是什麼？

是 review。

以前一天收幾個 PR，現在 agent 一小時就能丟你幾十個。看不完，就只能按 approve，然後祈禱 rollback 夠快。

AWS 說別再當 agent 的保母，但少盯場只是把工作從盯 agent 換成稽核 agent。

接下來最搶手的工程師，不是最會下 prompt 的，是敢對 merge 負責的。

An agent deleted a syllabus. Another leaked identity data.

Neither went rogue. They did exactly what their permissions allowed.

That's the uncomfortable part: agent safety is mostly a plumbing problem, not an alignment problem. File access, credentials, tool scopes.

Palo Alto reportedly offering $500M for Clutch tells you where the money is going.

Next year's hottest security category: identity management for things that aren't people.

Anthropic 一邊準備 IPO，一邊被報告指出正用 AI 自動化 AI 研發，進步速度翻倍。

同一時間，OpenAI 目標募 300 億美元，只募到 110 億。

投資人現在問的不是「AI 多強」，而是「什麼時候賺錢」。

「AI 自我改進」聽起來是終極護城河，也是最難驗證的說法。

Anthropic 的公開說明書，會是第一份必須拿證據回答這題的文件。

業界在吵 AI 網路戰，攻擊者卻用預設密碼讓儲血室升溫。

AI 讓攻擊變強是真的，但很多受害者根本撐不到 AI 出場那一步。

密碼沒改、韌體沒更新、設備直接掛在網路上。

資安廠商的簡報裡全是 AI，客戶冰箱的密碼還是 admin。

你們公司連網的設備總共幾台，現在有人答得出來嗎？

給 AI agent 檔案權限、帳密、工具存取，然後期待它「自己小心一點」？

這不叫護欄，這叫許願。

刪掉教學大綱、外洩身分資料，這些事故都不是 AI 叛變，是權限給太大。

Palo Alto 傳出開價 5 億美元買 Clutch，agent 資安已經自成一個市場。

台灣企業還在問要不要導入 agent，更該先問的是：導入之後，誰負責把權限收回來？

AI didn't just eat the GPUs. It ate your phone's RAM.

Oppo reportedly cancelled a flagship. Premium e-readers jumped $40 to $50.

Apple will pass the cost on and keep its margins. Smaller brands will cut models or eat the loss.

Memory shortages don't hurt everyone equally. They consolidate markets.

By the end of 2027, mid-range Android will have fewer brands and higher prices.

40 out of 41.

That's how many local ballot measures voters backed to restrict data centers.

More than $400 million in tech-backed campaign money couldn't change that.

Everyone kept watching chips and power grids as AI's limit. The real limit turned out to be a zoning board and a few thousand annoyed neighbors.

My bet: within two years, buying local consent costs more than buying the land.

黃仁勳被中國間諜盯上的新聞很聳動，但真正該緊張的是另一件事。

一個美方核准購買 H200 的買家，地址查下去是一間空辦公室。

間諜案考驗的是一個人，空辦公室考驗的卻是整套出口管制。

連買家是不是真的存在都沒確認，那管制到底擋住了誰？

我猜接下來華府會把審查責任推到輝達頭上，台灣供應鏈的客戶查核壓力也會一起上來。

Forget the honeypot headline for a second.

A US-approved buyer for H200s turned out to be an empty office. That's not espionage. That's paperwork nobody checked.

Export controls are only as strong as the checks behind each license.

Last month, Nvidia saying Megaspeed has no China ties was enough. Next month it won't be.

Prediction: within a year, chipmakers become legally responsible for checking who actually ends up with their chips.

AI 一秒推 7,200 次 code，你的 reviewer 還在看第一個 PR。

寫程式已經不是瓶頸了，審查、測試、出事能不能 rollback 才是。

GitHub、GitLab、Cursor、Google 都在把平台改成以 agent 為中心，不是沒有原因。

沒有護欄會怎樣？已經有 agent 直接把整份課綱刪掉了。

接下來兩年最搶手的工程師，不是寫最快的那個，而是敢為 merge 負責的那個。

AI 泡沫沒有破，是開始被查帳了。

OpenAI 目標募 300 億美元，最後只募到 110 億。

Ramp 數據顯示企業 AI 支出開始持平，但 token 用量還在漲。
用得更多，付的錢卻沒變多，這才是重點。

投資人不再為成長故事買單，要看變現，所以聊天機器人開始放廣告。

Anthropic 偏偏這時候 IPO，會被打折賣，還是成為第一個交出漂亮成績單的 AI 實驗室？

AI 產業花了好幾年遊說華府，結果輸在密西根的地方投票。

41 個地方公投，有 40 個支持限制資料中心。

科技業砸了超過 4 億美元的競選經費，還是沒換到鄰居點頭。

台灣也別以為事不關己。
用電、用水、噪音，這些問題在桃園、在台南一樣會被拿出來問。

下一個卡住 AI 的，可能不是 GPU 交期，是里民大會。

Writing code is now the cheap part.

The cost has moved to whoever owns the merge button.

Agents open more PRs in an hour than a team can properly review in a week. So teams quietly start rubber-stamping, and the human in the loop becomes a human somewhere near the loop.

The next big dev tools company won't sell a better code generator. It'll sell a better "no."

Which senior engineer on your team is about to approve PRs full-time?

Gated AI hacking models had about a seven-month head start. It's gone.

Free Chinese models now nearly match them at hacking. OpenAI rates GPT-6 Cyber's exploit skills as critical.

But finding bugs isn't the scary part. Fixing them is. Linux distros already can't ship patches as fast as bugs get found.

When finding bugs is free and patching is slow, attackers win on math alone.

2027 is the year patch speed becomes a board-level metric.

Token usage: up.
Enterprise AI spend: flat.

Those two lines are the whole AI business model problem.

Customers use more AI and pay the same. Price cuts are eating the growth.

So the labs reach for the oldest revenue model on the internet: ads.

When your chatbot starts recommending products, that's not a new feature. It's a slide from the investor deck.

Anthropic's IPO will be priced on this reality, not the hype.

AI 資料中心把記憶體吃光，帳單最後寄到你家。

手機機種被砍、電子書閱讀器漲價，自組 PC 快變成有錢人的嗜好。

Apple 有定價權，漲價你還是會買。二線品牌沒有，只能砍規格或直接退場。

台灣記憶體廠這波賺翻，下游組裝和通路卻會很痛。

明年的中階手機，8GB RAM 搞不好又變回「旗艦配置」。

業界忙著談 AI 網路戰，攻擊者卻用預設密碼讓儲血室升溫。

AI 確實讓找漏洞變便宜了，但多數受害者根本不是被頂級模型打穿的，而是門本來就沒鎖。

網路上還有幾百個自主駭客工具就這樣曝露著，誰都能撿來用。

你公司的 IoT 設備，有幾台還在用出廠密碼？

下一次大規模事件，十之八九不是 AI 打進來的，是 admin/admin。

The Cybertruck is dead, and the lesson is simple: preorders are not demand.

Refundable $100 deposits bought headlines, not buyers.

Now its factory space goes to robotaxis that haven't shipped yet. Tesla is trading one unproven bet for another.

The EV that wins the next five years is a cheap, small hatchback, not a stainless-steel wedge.

Who builds it for the US market first: Tesla, Detroit, or whoever gets past the tariffs on BYD?

Cybertruck 停產，最好的教訓就一句：預購量不等於需求量。

100 美元的可退訂金，換來的是新聞版面，不是買家。

更妙的是，騰出來的產線要給還沒上路的 Robotaxi。
拿一個沒驗證過的賭注，換另一個沒驗證過的賭注。

電動車市場要的是便宜、小台、好停車，比亞迪早就懂了。

我猜 Tesla 下一台真正賣爆的車，會長得很無聊。

AI didn't just eat the GPUs. It's eating the RAM in your next phone.

Data centers are absorbing so much memory that phones are getting canceled, e-readers are getting pricier, and building a PC is turning into a luxury hobby.

Apple can pass the cost along. Everyone else shrinks.

The weird result: AI makes consumer hardware less competitive, not more.

Prediction: in 2027, base models quietly get worse specs at the same price.
